text: Then Jehovah{H3068} answered{H6030} Job{H347} out of the whirlwind,{H5591} and said,{H6030}
Who is this that darkeneth{H2821} counsel{H6098} By words{H4405} without knowledge?{H1847}

When the morning{H1242} stars{H3556} sang{H7442} together,{H3162} And all the sons{H1121} of God{H430} shouted{H7321} for joy?
Or [who] shut up{H5526} the sea{H3220} with doors,{H1817} When it brake forth,{H1518} [as if] it had issued out{H3318} of the womb;{H7358}
When I made{H7760} clouds{H6051} the garment{H3830} thereof, And thick darkness{H6205} a swaddling-band{H2854} for it,
And marked{H7665} out for it my bound,{H2706} And set{H7760} bars{H1280} and doors,{H1817}
And said,{H559} Hitherto{H5704} shalt thou come,{H935} but no further;{H3254} And here shall thy proud{H1347} waves{H1530} be stayed?{H7896}

And from the wicked{H7563} their light{H216} is withholden,{H4513} And the high{H7311} arm{H2220} is broken.{H7665}
Hast thou entered{H935} into the springs{H5033} of the sea?{H3220} Or hast thou walked{H1980} in the recesses{H2714} of the deep?{H8415}
Have the gates{H8179} of death{H4194} been revealed{H1540} unto thee? Or hast thou seen{H7200} the gates{H8179} of the shadow of death?{H6757}
Hast thou comprehended{H995} the earth{H776} in its breadth?{H7338} Declare,{H5046} if thou knowest{H3045} it all.

That thou shouldest take{H3947} it to the bound{H1366} thereof, And that thou shouldest discern{H995} the paths{H5410} to the house{H1004} thereof?
[ Doubtless], thou knowest,{H3045} for thou wast then born,{H3205} And the number{H4557} of thy days{H3117} is great!{H7227}
Hast thou entered{H935} the treasuries{H214} of the snow,{H7950} Or hast thou seen{H7200} the treasures{H214} of the hail,{H1259}
Which I have reserved{H2820} against the time{H6256} of trouble,{H6862} Against the day{H3117} of battle{H7128} and war?{H4421}

To cause it to rain{H4305} on a land{H776} where no man{H376} is; On the wilderness,{H4057} wherein there is no man;{H120}
To satisfy{H7646} the waste{H4875} and desolate{H7722} [ground], And to cause the tender{H4161} grass{H1877} to spring forth?{H6779}

When the dust{H6083} runneth{H3332} into a mass,{H4165} And the clods{H7263} cleave fast together?{H1692}
